comparison.objective: Install a bracket, versus fit and bolt an inside-bolt-circle gasket between flanges.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-less bracket alignment/latching versus flexible gasket placement and sequential bolt insertion around a flange.
comparison.success_condition: Correct OpenU, all mounts engaged, and no interference versus centred flat gasket, four inserted bolts, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: The flange task tests gasket positioning and bolt insertion; generic multi-hole alignment alone does not prove overlap.
